title: Peripheral_Monocytes_HC01
extract_protocol_ch1: Peripheral Blood Mononuclear Cells (PBMC) were obtained by centrifugation in Ficoll®Paque PLUS (GE Healthcare). Total monocytes were enriched from PBMC using negative magnetic selection (Pan-monocyte isolation kit, Miltenyi Biotech). Cells were then washed twice in Phosphate Buffered Saline(Ca2+ and Mg2+ -free) containing 0.04% Bovine Serum Albumin.

Samples were loaded to the Chromium Chip B Single Cell Kit (PN-1000074) using the Chromium Single Cell 3' GEM, Library & Gel Bead Kit v3 (PN-1000092) as described in the manufacturer’s user guide (10X Genomics, California, USA), aiming to capture 1000 cells per sample. 11 cycles of cDNA amplification were performed on the purified GEM-RT product, and cDNA was examined for quality using the Agilent 2200 Tapestation with the High-sensitivity D5000 screentape and reagents (Agilent Technologies, Waldbronn, Germany), and the Qubit® 2.0 Fluorometer and Qubit dsDNA HS Assay Kit (Life Technologies, California, USA). 10µL of cDNA was used to prepare the 10X 3’RNA library and 13 cycles were used for sample index PCR. Final cleaned libraries were quantified using the Qubit® 2.0 Fluorometer and Qubit dsDNA HS Assay Kit and average fragment size checked using the Agilent D1000 screentape and reagents.  An equimolar amount of each sample library was pooled for sequencing on one lane of an Illumina NovaSeq S4 flow cell at 150bp paired-end.
data_processing: Demultplexing, barcoded processing,  gene counting and aggregation were performed using 10x Genomics Cell Ranger pipeline (version 6.0.2).

title: Peripheral_Monocytes_CD04
extract_protocol_ch1: Peripheral Blood Mononuclear Cells (PBMC) were obtained by centrifugation in Ficoll®Paque PLUS (GE Healthcare). Total monocytes were enriched from PBMC using negative magnetic selection (Pan-monocyte isolation kit, Miltenyi Biotech). Cells were then washed twice in Phosphate Buffered Saline(Ca2+ and Mg2+ -free) containing 0.04% Bovine Serum Albumin.

Samples were loaded to the Chromium Chip B Single Cell Kit (PN-1000074) using the Chromium Single Cell 3' GEM, Library & Gel Bead Kit v3 (PN-1000092) as described in the manufacturer’s user guide (10X Genomics, California, USA), aiming to capture 1000 cells per sample. 11 cycles of cDNA amplification were performed on the purified GEM-RT product, and cDNA was examined for quality using the Agilent 2200 Tapestation with the High-sensitivity D5000 screentape and reagents (Agilent Technologies, Waldbronn, Germany), and the Qubit® 2.0 Fluorometer and Qubit dsDNA HS Assay Kit (Life Technologies, California, USA). 10µL of cDNA was used to prepare the 10X 3’RNA library and 13 cycles were used for sample index PCR. Final cleaned libraries were quantified using the Qubit® 2.0 Fluorometer and Qubit dsDNA HS Assay Kit and average fragment size checked using the Agilent D1000 screentape and reagents.  An equimolar amount of each sample library was pooled for sequencing on one lane of an Illumina NovaSeq S4 flow cell at 150bp paired-end.
data_processing: Demultplexing, barcoded processing,  gene counting and aggregation were performed using 10x Genomics Cell Ranger pipeline (version 6.0.2).
Assembly: GRCh38 GENCODE v2/ Ensembl 98
Supplementary files format and content: Tab-separated values files and matrix files
